result.stdout:
Bielu.Overlay.Cli - Apply and validate OpenAPI Overlays

Usage: dotnet overlay <command> [options]

Commands:
  apply          Apply overlays to an API description
  validate       Validate overlay documents

apply options:
  --file <path>            The description to transform - OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or Arazzo (required)
  --overlay <path>         An overlay to apply (required, repeatable - applied in order)
  --output <path>          Where to write the result (default: standard output)
  --format <json|yaml>     Output format (default: inferred from --output extension, else json)
  --strict                 Treat a target matching zero nodes as an error

validate options:
  --file <path>            Path or glob to overlay document(s) (required, repeatable)
  --strict                 Treat warnings as errors
  --format <text|json>     Output format (default: text)

  -h, --help               Show this help message
